entities.summary: Palace Revolt, a transformative movement in Thailand (1910–1932). Emerged from Franco-Siamese Crisis — Siam cedes Laos to France and Chulalongkorn abolishes slavery and modernizes the administration. Catalyzed Vajiravudh and Late Absolute Monarchy.
